text:
Nina: Quick heads-up — external pen test kickoff planned for next week. Assessor: RedFox. Scope: staging cluster (ingest + API gateway), telemetry pipeline, identity/RBAC surface. Proposed window: Thu 2026-04-02 09:00-13:00 UTC. Pls flag blockers.
Jamal: I can do infra oncall for that window. Need to validate ephemeral role flow for assessors.
Aisha: FYI staging has new ingest lambda + new API rate limiter change. Will doc the endpoints.
Nina: Thx. Two major question buckets: 1) RBAC — which ephemeral roles do we hand over vs read-only? 2) KMS/audit — can we provide encrypted log export for evidence without exposing keys?
Carlos: For RBAC I suggest: read-only for service accounts + scoped token for admin ops (timeboxed). We'll use the existing ephemeral role playbook.
Jamal: Confirming we can create an assessor IAM role limited to assume-role for 4h via our KMS-proxy. Need approval on ephemeral policy: ```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-staging"}
  ]
}
```
Nina: That policy looks fine, Jamal — but add condition on source IP range + MFA session tag.
Aisha: About KMS: we can't hand over CMK. We can create a decrypt-as-a-service endpoint that returns plaintext logs to a presigned S3 for the assessor. That mirrors our previous PT pattern.
Carlos: Agree. We'll generate ephemeral presigned S3 + signed URL bundle with read-only access. Store evidence to s3://sec-evidence/pt-redfox/1761012345/.
pt-bot: New ticket created: SEC-4821 (PenTest RedFox intake) — https://zendesk.example/SEC-4821
Nina: Good. Who will own evidence packaging and timestamped hash? Need chain-of-custody.
Jamal: I'll own packaging. I'll run the hash export and upload manifest. I'll need help with KMS-proxy to sign the manifest.
Aisha: I can add a small hook in ingest that emits a forensic-level log stream to the readroom. Will keep retention at 90 days for this engagement.
Nina: Retention 90 days is OK for this engagement only. After retest close we'll revert. Add that to the ticket.
Carlos: Remediation tracker — propose we use the SEC board and tag fixes with "pt-redfox" and severity. Can we publish a mini SLA: triage within 48h, hotfix within 7 days for P1?
Nina: Yes. I'll post triage cadence: daily standup for first 72h, then 3x week until resolved.
Jamal: One more: telemetry sampling may include sensitive PII in traces. Need to run scrubbing job before sharing. Aisha will own scrub template.
Aisha: On it. I'll attach scrub list to SEC-4821 by EOD today.
Nina: Retest coordination: assessor asked for a follow-up retest window 2 weeks after initial report. Tentative retest: Thu 2026-04-16 09:00-12:00 UTC. Can ops hold capacity?
Jamal: I'll reserve the slot with a low-impact gating policy (no production traffic).
Carlos: We should run a dry-run of the assessor access next Tue 2026-03-31 14:00 UTC — quick 30m handoff to validate roles, KMS-proxy, presigned S3, and manifest signing.
Nina: Perfect. Action items: 
- Nina: create SEC-4821 template and cadence notes (done)
- Jamal: create assessor role + policy + presigned S3 (due 2026-03-31 12:00 UTC)
- Aisha: scrub template + endpoint docs (due 2026-03-31 EOD)
- Carlos: remediation board and SLA doc (due 2026-03-31 EOD)
- Jamal + Nina: run dry-run 2026-03-31 14:00 UTC (30m)
Jamal: I'll also prepare the log export script: `./tools/export_forensic.sh --since 48h --compress --manifest` and will paste output during dry-run.
Aisha: Leaving a note: the new rate-limiter may affect assessor fuzzing. I'll create a perf-exemption flag for the assessor role.
Nina: Thanks everyone. If no blockers, I'll schedule the dry-run and post calendar invites. :thumbsup:
Carlos: :thumbsup: +1 on chain-of-custody manifest format — use SHA256 and include S3 path + timestamp in ticket.
pt-bot: Reminder: upload evidence to protected workspace only. Audit log stream flagged.
Nina: Closing thread — will post updates in SEC-4821 and the dry-run notes after Tue.
